name: MLPerf v5.0 HPE DL380a Gen12 8x L40S: llama2-70b-99.9 Server p99 first-token latency
unit: ms, p99 first-token latency at an 11 qps target, 8x L40S
methodology: Same Server run as mlperf-v5-0-hpe-dl380a-8xl40s-llama2-70b-server-tokens. mlperf_log_summary.txt prints 99.00 percentile first token latency 525500719 ns, which is 525.5 ms. This is the latency of one request inside an aggregate serving run (samples_per_query 1, target_qps 11, TTFT cap 2000 ms), not a single-stream batch-1 measurement. p50 was 198.7 ms and p99.9 was 711.7 ms in the same log.
notes: Recorded at p99 rather than the mean because the Server scenario's constraint is a percentile cap. Not comparable with a batch-1 TTFT from llama-bench.
